description: Source-level release checks for the bounded, offline spatial atlas. Separate browser QA is required for visual quality and interaction.

checks.description: The generated workbench remains self-contained and denies network, workers, frames, objects, and unsafe DOM rendering.
The spatial 3D atlas opens by default; an optional planar view and a text alternative remain available when Canvas is unavailable.
Perspective 3D has visible mode controls, bounded canvas input, reset and zoom alternatives, and an accessible text status.
Mode, selection, focus, and 3D navigation are operable and announced without requiring a pointer.
A user motion control, reduced-motion preference, and hidden-document pause prevent compulsory or wasteful animation.
Forced-colors, non-color semantics, minimum control targets, and narrow-screen reflow remain available.
3D nodes, edges, frame work, and initial positions are explicitly finite and deterministic.
A snapshot without the newer quality envelope still renders deterministically with 2D available.
